name: car_closeup
pre: (() => { const g = window.__MW.game; window.__MW.spawnTestCar({ finish: 'pearl', color: '#5b1a8c', livery: 'flames' }, -40, 8, 1.1); window.__MW.teleport(-48, 14); return true; })()

name: palace_cinema
pre: (() => { const c = window.__MW.game.cinema; const p = c.local(0, 0, 18); window.__MW.__cine = [p.x + 8, 4.5, p.z + (c.rot ? -10 : 10), c.center.x, 4, c.center.z - 14 * Math.cos(c.rot)]; return window.__MW.__cine; })()
